# Stdin, repeated calls, byte preservation, and native fuzz output.
mcpcorpus 0 calls.mcp -tool search -out fuzz
stdout 'wrote 1 seeds'
cmp fuzz/29a9829b3c03948275ca3be1cb7b633c0207849d2c0bd3215060f2ac05abce64 expected.fuzz

# Explicit JSON mode and file input.
mcpcorpus 0 empty -tool search -out json -format json calls.mcp
cmp json/29a9829b3c03948275ca3be1cb7b633c0207849d2c0bd3215060f2ac05abce64.json expected.json

# Refuse existing directories and preserve unrelated files.
mcpcorpus 1 calls.mcp -tool search -out existing
stderr 'file exists'
cmp existing/keep keep

# A malformed trailing record must not leave any output.
mcpcorpus 1 bad.mcp -tool search -out bad
stderr 'record 2'
! exists bad

# Missing and null arguments fail rather than inventing empty arguments.
mcpcorpus 1 absent.mcp -tool search -out absent
stderr 'arguments must be a JSON object'
! exists absent
mcpcorpus 1 null.mcp -tool search -out null
stderr 'arguments must be a JSON object'
! exists null

# No selected call and missing options must not create files.
mcpcorpus 1 calls.mcp -tool other -out no-calls
stderr 'no calls'
! exists no-calls
mcpcorpus 1 empty -out missing
stderr 'required:'
mcpcorpus 0 empty -h
stderr 'Usage of mcpcorpus'

-- calls.mcp --
mcp-send {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search","arguments":{"q":"a"}}}
mcp-send {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search","arguments":{"q":"a"}}}
-- bad.mcp --
mcp-send {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search","arguments":{}}}
mcp-send {"jsonrpc":
-- absent.mcp --
mcp-send {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search"}}
-- null.mcp --
mcp-send {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search","arguments":null}}
-- expected.fuzz --
go test fuzz v1
[]byte("{\"q\":\"a\"}")
-- expected.json --
{"q":"a"}
-- existing/keep --
unrelated
-- keep --
unrelated
-- empty --
